title: 32 km inversion, 12 TAO lmvm iterations under full_mumps on the solver-reuse change, against the issue #157 TAO arm
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp under full_mumps, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb), byte-identical to Quartz's antarctica/data; ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; sub-element friction with the exact front push (ISMIP7_SUBELEMENT_FRICTION=1), bi-Laplacian prior (sigma 0.3, rho 7.5 km), full_mumps, no dH/dt term; log-speed weight 0; TAO lmvm with the mass-consistent metric (ISMIP7_GRAD_PRECOND=mass_consistent)
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs
resources: 4 ranks, beside the unit suite; peak 3.1 GB a rank
code: c7ea173 (PR 155 with the solver reuse); icepack_tools e7b923e
cost: 393 s wall; 13.6 to 14.1 s an iteration of one evaluation, about 30 s at a rescued one
audit: 12 TAO iterations, objective 7.849914e4 to 2.433756e4; every iteration's objective within 1.7e-15 and gradient norm within 1.8e-14 of test-32km-inversion-opt-tao (4cf7f0e) at the same iteration, with the same six rescued trial points
notes: checks the TAO path's assigned control copies under full_mumps, the production default, which the slab tests cover under scpc_gamg only; the seconds are no before/after measurement, since the reference arm ran beside two others
